page_title: AST 2-2 BHA | Aston Villa v Brighton 30/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Craig Pawson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
90+6' The resulting corner, taken by John McGinn (Aston Villa), comes to nothing.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Igor (Brighton) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jakub Moder (Brighton) replacing Carlos Baleba.
85' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Here is a change. Lucas Digne is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
83' Today's match ends for Boubacar Kamara who will be replaced by Amadou Onana (Aston Villa).
83' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Youri Tielemans will be replaced by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
81' 2 - 2 Goal! Joao Pedro plays a simple square pass into the feet of Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
77' Here comes a substitution. Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Leon Bailey.

75' A rebound falls to Carlos Baleba (Brighton) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Emiliano Martinez anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.
75' Brighton are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
72' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
71' The foul by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) was seen by Craig Pawson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
69' Substitution. Yasin Ayari will be replaced by Matt O'Riley (Brighton).
68' Looks like Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
67' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

66' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
62' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Brighton as they win a corner.

61' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Bart Verbruggen pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
58' Substitution. Brajan Gruda did his best and is replaced by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton).
58' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Simon Adingra is replaced by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton).
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Georginio Rutter (Brighton) will replace Julio Enciso.

56' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
54' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
53' John McGinn (Aston Villa) sends the corner into the box, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts it and averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.
50' Igor (Brighton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
49' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

47' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Ollie Watkins. The score is now 2:1.
46' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
46' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+13' The end of the first half.
45+12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
45+11' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45+11' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee signals a corner kick to Aston Villa.
45+7' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Yasin Ayari (Brighton) for his blatant foul.

45+6' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
45+3' Booking. Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) receives a caution from the referee.
45+2' Simon Adingra (Brighton) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
45' There will be a minimum of 12 min. of added time.
44' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brighton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Simon Adingra (Brighton) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
38' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
36' 1 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bart Verbruggen into the bottom left corner.
36' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is going to take the penalty!
35' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Aston Villa!
34' Referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Aston Villa. Let’s see what happens!
33' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
33' Chance! Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Bart Verbruggen is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
32' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Aston Villa players are visibly unhappy with the call.

31' Play continues despite the shouts by some Aston Villa players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Craig Pawson interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
30' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

27' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
27' The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.

26' Julio Enciso (Brighton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Emiliano Martinez! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
23' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
22' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Problems for Unai Emery as Pau Torres is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) replaces him.
20' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
17' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
14' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
12' 0 - 1 Goal Simon Adingra (Brighton)! Simon Adingra (Brighton) was put through by Joao Pedro and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 0:1.
12' Aston Villa take a short corner kick.

11' A big rebound finds it way to Pau Torres (Aston Villa), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
9' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
8' The free kick is delivered by Yasin Ayari (Brighton) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
7' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) commits a rough foul. Craig Pawson stops the game and makes a call. Brighton have a free kick.
5' Joao Pedro (Brighton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
2' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Craig Pawson.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
